'''Hanaal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], she owned a small shop where she bought, sold, and created artifacts and relics.
